notes.title: Russian Translation Released - Community Items and 1.0.4. Update Notes!
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone![/b]

[b]We have update the game to version 1.0.4.[/b]

With this, we now have [b]Russian translation available[/b] in the game - you can switch to it in the preferences menu in the game.

We have also fixed bugs, typos and other weird behavior, but we probably missed some - so if you find anything, hop on our Discord server and let us know!

[b]We also added 33 animations to the already existing end game content, mostly to Ruby's and Sofia's scenes.[/b]

Community Items are also available now:
- 11 Trading Cards
- 4 Profile Backgrounds
- Badges
- Emoticons

We are currently working on more translations - the next one to come out will most likely be [b]Portuguese[/b].
We are also trying to get the game translated to Chinese, but no promises on that yet.

Thank you guys for the lots of positive reviews and feedback, we really appreciate it!
More content is coming, as I am working on adding more sandbox content to a lot of the girls. This will come out as a free update and I'll post more news about in the coming weeks.

Thank you and see you guys in the next one!
-Dr Sin
